desc:
A Windows 95 desktop. A fishing game. Numbers going up forever.
Catch fish. They're weird.

The latest in fishing innovation, catch fish with the convenience of FISH.OS. No more getting wet or briny, fish from the comfort of your home. Click the water. Watch the numbers go up. Fill your aquarium.

🎣 Tap to fish, auto-click included! 
🐡 200+ collectible fish (they get weirder the deeper you go) 
🚤 Manage your fleet to optimize your FPS (Fish per Second) 
🔄 Prestige your way to fishing fame.
📈 Sell live fish on a live market, ethically sound! 
🏆 Aquarium = your flex. Fill it with legends. 
🤝 Trade your fish and treasures! 
⭐ More fish for Premium members.
🤼 Tournament every Saturday!

Your aquarium is your trophy wall. Fill it. Flex it.
